info.bio:
Nombre de nacimiento: Troyal Garth Brooks
Nacionalidad: Americana
Fecha de nacimiento: 07 de febrero 1962 (50 años)

Garth Brooks es uno de los más exitosos cantautores de la historia americana. Hasta la fecha ha vendido más de 123 millones de álbumes en los EE.UU., construyó una gran proyección internacional, y disfrutó de cross-over éxito en los EE.UU. y en el extranjero.

scenes.name: Roots-rock de los ochenta y cow-punk
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Como en 1970 tras 1966, la new wave de 1976 va seguida de un revival del roots-rock, esta vez gradual y disfrazado: punks que desfiguran los estilos tradicionales (X, Dream Syndicate, Gun Club) y los «cow-punks» que tocan country ambientado entre inadaptados: Long Ryders, Jason & The Scorchers, Fetchin Bones, Lone Justice, Beat Farmers. El populismo de Los Lobos, Del Fuegos, Del-Lords y Walkabouts; en la Costa Oeste, los dementes Camper Van Beethoven, Donner Party, Catheads, Thin White Rope y los American Music Club de Mark Eitzel; en Texas, Wild Seeds, Poi Dog Pondering, Glass Eye; en los Grandes Lagos, BoDeans, Soul Asylum, Afghan Whigs, Shrimp Boat y los canadienses Cowboy Junkies. Nashville se renueva con los neotradicionalistas (George Strait, Randy Travis, Garth Brooks, Lyle Lovett, Steve Earle, Dwight Yoakam) y el surf instrumental vuelve con Shadowy Men On A Shadowy Planet.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …(1982) set the pace for the rest of the pack. Randy Travis' Storms Of Life (1986) Clint Black's Killin' Time (1989) also set standards, but it was Garth Brooks who became the superstar of the neo-traditionalists with the numerous hits off No Fences (1990) and Ropin' the Wind (1991). These were the stars.…

podcast.title: 90s Country Rock Sound
podcast.body: The country music popular in the 1990s, exemplified by Garth Brooks, is described as essentially country rock. "the country of the 90s that Garth Brooks brand of country is essentially country rock."

podcast.title: Marketability in Country Music
podcast.body: Garth Brooks was cited as an example of an artist who was significantly easier to market within the country music industry compared to artists like Katie Lang, suggesting a preference for certain artist profiles in promotion. "It was a lot easier to market Garth Brooks or Blake Shelton than Katie Lang."

podcast.title: SoundScan Beneficiary - Country Sales
podcast.body: Before the introduction of SoundScan technology, country records like those by Garth Brooks were widely perceived as not selling well. However, SoundScan revealed that country music was actually selling far more copies than anyone in the industry had previously realized, making artists like Brooks significant beneficiaries of the new accurate sales tracking system. "Country records, which were thought to be dogs, were actually selling far, far more than anybody realized. Garth Brooks for example."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
